appeal.passage_context: Job.38.39-Job.39.12 within Yahweh’s first whirlwind speech Job.38.1-Job.40.2 and the divine encounter Job.38.1-Job.42.6.
appeal.rationale: Job.39.5 begins a fresh interrogative (“Who has sent out the wild donkey free?”) and changes the governing human-inability test. Job.38.39-39.4 asks whether Job provides prey or knows hidden wild birth; Job.39.5-12 asks whether Job can release, domesticate, trust, or enlist wild donkey and wild ox. The whole animal series remains a valid parent, but collapsing these functions reduces retrieval precision and makes the donkey/ox domestication contrast inaccessible except inside a fifteen-verse mixed tableau.
appeal.uncertainty: No new speaker formula occurs, the entire span is one continuous animal series, and the boss records the 39:5 start as single-lane evidence. Those facts justify mandatory parent hydration and continued held status if needed, but reviewer count is not authority and they do not erase the explicit interrogative and rhetorical-function reset.
